Welcome! I’m really glad you’re here, because together, we’re about to set off on an adventure that stretches across the universe itself. Have you ever stared up at the night sky and wondered where we fit in—what our place is among all those stars? Cosmos, brought to life by Carl Sagan, invites us to explore those big questions—about how life began, how intelligence evolved, and just how everything, from distant galaxies to our own breath, is deeply connected. As we move forward, we’ll discover that the story of the cosmos isn’t some far-off tale—it’s really the story of us. We’ll feel the wonder of science, the thrill of discovery, and maybe even a bit of humility as we realize just how vast and mysterious the universe can be.
Imagine traveling from the birth of stars to the rise of civilizations, weaving together scientific breakthroughs, moments of deep reflection, and our never-ending curiosity. We’ll look at how life on Earth has changed, how human culture has grown, and even dream about the possibility of life somewhere out there. This isn’t just about facts—it’s an open invitation to wonder, to question, and to appreciate just how fragile and extraordinary life really is. As we explore, the lines between science and pure wonder start to blur, opening the door to a deeper understanding of both the universe and our own story within it. So, let’s begin this journey together—ready to be inspired, to be amazed, and to see our connection to everything, both out there and right here at home.
